crazyChanges.name: Global Mechanics
crazyChanges.blurb: Every hero starts the game much beefier: base Health 120 to 200, while Strength gives less per point (22 to 20).
crazyChanges.line: Base hero Health increased from 120 to 200

crazyChanges.name: Global Mechanics
crazyChanges.blurb: Illusions can finally use on-hit items. New stat "Item Potency" decides how strong, 20% for illusions by default.
crazyChanges.line: Illusions have a default Item Potency of 20% and can now apply most item on hit effects

crazyChanges.name: Global Mechanics
crazyChanges.blurb: Passive gold is now flat all game (90 a minute), and everyone passively earns 50 XP a minute after the horn.
crazyChanges.line: Passive gold per minute no longer scales over game time

crazyChanges.name: Meepo
crazyChanges.blurb: Meepo goes Universal, loses MegaMeepo, and drops 9 base damage.
crazyChanges.line: Meepo is now a Universal hero

crazyChanges.name: Juggernaut
crazyChanges.blurb: Juggernaut loses Swiftslash entirely, and Blade Fury now fully disarms him.

crazyChanges.name: Medusa
crazyChanges.blurb: Gorgon's Grasp flips from Physical to Magical, casts in 0.2s, and trades its DoT (100 to 12/24/36/48) for a much bigger hit (30/70/110/150 to 60/120/180/240).
crazyChanges.line: Damage Over Time decreased from 100 to 12/24/36/48

crazyChanges.name: Batrider
crazyChanges.blurb: Sticky Napalm: half the max stacks (20 to 10), but each stack hits much harder (2.5/5/7.5/10 to 6/12/18/24 damage).

crazyChanges.name: Dazzle
crazyChanges.blurb: Nothl Projection can now be ended after just 1s (was 5s) and travels faster (1200 to 1700).

crazyChanges.name: Greater Horn of Battle
crazyChanges.blurb: New Greater Horn of Battle drops from Tormentor: global cast, no cooldown, summons mega creeps with a siege unit and flagbearer on every lane.
crazyChanges.line: Global Cast Range. No Mana Cost. No cooldown

crazyChanges.name: Map Objectives
crazyChanges.blurb: Roshan comes back faster every time he dies, down to a 5 minute minimum.
crazyChanges.line: Base respawn timer now decreases by 1 minute every time Roshan is defeated, to a minimum of 5 minutes

crazyChanges.name: Lane Creeps, Towers and Bases
crazyChanges.blurb: The map itself moved: the Dire fountain slides ~300 units closer to the Ancient, and Twin Gates go to the top and bottom rims.
crazyChanges.line: Dire fountain moved ~300 units closer to the Dire Ancient

crazyChanges.name: Death Prophet
crazyChanges.blurb: Death Prophet's every attack now sends out a ghost (15% + 1% per level of her damage) that heals her for 50% of what it dealt, yet her attack range drops from 600 to 500.
crazyChanges.line: Now also creates a ghost whenever Death Prophet attacks an enemy. The spirit deals a portion of Death Prophet's attack damage, and then heals her for 50% of the damage dealt upon return
